assessment_order: Verify completed native/TCP match for all six 240x240 planes, same header settings and actual action/end provenance.
Inspect raw F/B full fields and corresponding fixed C1/C3/D4 regions for recognizable targets, continuity, repeated directional distortion and broad impairment.
Inspect target region and C2 independently; record local morphology change without treating it as global tip failure.

If fixed-region features move, inspect independent landmarks and terrace edge together to distinguish displacement from disappearance. Preserve raw pair; any shifted view is separate secondary evidence.

Report induction effect as usable, degraded, or uncertain with concrete trace/retrace evidence and limits. Degraded requires functional impairment beyond an expected local surface modification; no successful dirty-repair-clean cycle is inferred.
interpretation_limits: Root observed large post-action Z workpoint shift; raw global offsets are retained. A change in absolute Z or a single peak does not by itself determine imaging function.
I03 includes mapped lateral movement and one shaper operation; imaging change is associated with this composite exposure and cannot uniquely separate movement versus shaper contributions.
Height/width and F/B error metrics are descriptors, not automatic pass/fail thresholds. Tip contamination chemistry or atom transfer cannot be identified from these images alone.
